'''Philip Green''' (also published as '''Phillip Green''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Pleasanton tournament]] on 28 October 2000 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind Of Scum Tuskens]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1396">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-pleasanton-ca-10-28-00d1396/ pleasanton-ca-10-28-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 29 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-pleasanton-ca-10-28-00d1396/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Philip Green also played at [[August 2000 Pleasanton tournament]] on 20 August 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Ol Skool Profit]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1153">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-pleasonton-ca-9-20d1153/ pleasonton-ca-9-20], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 21 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-pleasonton-ca-9-20d1153/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
